An <c:ffff00>action<c> unique to the <c:ffff00>{{medachange_form}}<c>.
Like the actions of <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>, each Drive has the
following <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>.

Each <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> that has performed <c:ffff00>{{medachange}}<c> can
use 3 types of Drive: A, B and C.
